title: 11 Best Herbal Creams For Jet Lag
intro: Herbal creams for jet lag are topical preparations made from various plant extracts, such as herbs, essential oils, and botanicals, designed to alleviate the symptoms of jet lag. These creams offer numerous benefits, including reducing fatigue, improving sleep quality, and regulating the body's circadian rhythms. Examples of herbal creams used to treat jet lag include those containing ashwagandha, which helps to reduce stress and anxiety, as well as creams infused with lavender, peppermint, and chamomile, known for their calming and sleep-promoting properties. Additionally, creams featuring ingredients such as ginkgo biloba, valerian root, and passionflower are also used to help alleviate jet lag symptoms, as they are believed to enhance sleep quality and reduce jet lag-related fatigue.

preparations.preparation_desc: Valeriana officinalis creams are a popular herbal remedy used to treat the symptoms of jet lag, a common affliction experienced by travelers who cross multiple time zones. The calming and sedative properties of Valeriana officinalis creams help to regulate the body's internal clock, reducing symptoms such as insomnia, fatigue, and disorientation. The bioactive constituents of Valeriana officinalis creams, including valerenic acid, valeranone, and isovaleric acid, work together to promote relaxation and reduce stress levels, making it easier to adjust to a new sleep schedule. By using Valeriana officinalis creams, individuals can benefit from improved sleep quality, reduced travel-related stress, and a faster recovery from jet lag.
preparations.preparation_study: According to "American journal of health-system pharmacy : AJHP : official journal of the American Society of Health-System Pharmacists", Valeriana officinalis creams may be a potentially safe herbal therapy for alleviating insomnia associated with jet lag.

preparations.preparation_desc: Lavandula angustifolia creams have been traditionally used to treat jet lag ailments due to their soothing and calming properties, which help to regulate the body's internal clock and promote relaxation. The herbal preparation contains bioactive constituents such as linalool and linalyl acetate, which have been shown to have a sedative effect on the nervous system, thereby helping to alleviate symptoms of jet lag. These creams work by reducing stress and anxiety associated with travel and helping to regulate the body's natural sleep-wake cycle. The benefits of using Lavandula angustifolia creams to treat jet lag include improved sleep quality, reduced fatigue, and a faster recovery time, making them a popular natural remedy for this common travel-related disorder.

Melissa officinalis creams have been traditionally used to treat the symptoms of jet lag, a common condition that affects people who travel across different time zones. This herbal preparation is known for its adaptogenic properties, which help the body to adapt to new time zones by regulating the sleep-wake cycle and reducing stress levels. The bioactive constituents of Melissa officinalis creams, including rosmarinic acid, ursolic acid, and linalool, have been found to have a sedative and anti-inflammatory effect, which can help to alleviate symptoms of jet lag such as insomnia and fatigue. By using Melissa officinalis creams, individuals can benefit from improved sleep quality, reduced stress levels, and faster recovery from the effects of jet lag.
preparations.preparation_study: According to Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology, Melissa officinalis creams for jet lag may be beneficial due to its significant increase in brain-derived neurotrophic factor (BDNF) expression, particularly through primary metabolites belonging to the Krebs Cycle and secondary metabolites such as flavonoids, xanthone, and terpenoids.

The antispasmodic and sedative properties of this herbal preparation help to regulate sleep patterns and reduce anxiety, making it easier to adjust to new time zones. The bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, contribute to its therapeutic effects by promoting relaxation and reducing stress. By using Passiflora incarnata creams, individuals can benefit from improved sleep quality, reduced fatigue, and a faster recovery from jet lag symptoms.
